title: Robocon support arm: two-material selection
description: Illustrative teaching case using the same 100 mm x 20 mm arm, 10 N tip load, 0.50 mm deflection limit and minimum safety factor of 2. It compares the reference synthetic material with a lower-density, lower-modulus synthetic material to exercise selection across materials. Neither material is a real alloy or product.

materials.name: Synthetic aluminium-like teaching material 01
materials.provenance: Synthetic teaching fixture invented for METRON Milestone 1. Not a real alloy grade, not manufacturer data, and not for design use.
